# Set up environment and prepare data 
```{r}
# clear environment 
rm( list = ls() )

# load libraries
library(ape)
library(reshape2)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(jaccard)
library(adegenet)
library(vegan)
library(ggforce)
library(cowplot)
library(phytools)
library(prabclus)
library(xlsx)

# Load gene presence/absence  data
gene_pres_abs <- read.csv("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pangenome_analysis/gene_presence_absence.csv")

# List samples from each dataset
NL_metadata <- read.xlsx("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/0.Raw_data/Netherlands_Sanger_metadata.xlsx", 1) 
NLD_samples <- NL_metadata |> filter(ENA.lane.accession %in% colnames(gene_pres_abs)) |> pull(ENA.lane.accession)
CDC_metadata <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Typing/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC/phenotypes.txt", header=T) 
CDC_samples <- CDC_metadata |> filter(samples %in% colnames(gene_pres_abs)) |> pull(samples)

# Load metadata
phenotypes <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Phylogenies/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC_NL_TW/phenotypes_filtered.txt", header=T)|>
  rename(Sample =samples ) |> 
  mutate(Age_cat = ifelse(binary==0, "EOD", "LOD/VLOD"))
SCs <- read.csv("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Phylogenies/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC_NL_TW/GBS_GWAS_db_core_clusters.csv") |> rename(Sample=Taxon, SC=Cluster)
metadata <- left_join(SCs, phenotypes) |> 
  mutate(Country= ifelse(Sample %in% NLD_samples, "NL", 
                         ifelse(Sample %in% CDC_samples, "USA", "TW")) )|> 
  filter(Country != "TW")

# Import tree
setwd("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Phylogenies/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC_NL_TW")
Fasttree <- read.tree("FastTree_phylo.tre")
Fasttree_mid <- midpoint.root(Fasttree)
Fasttree_mid_clean <- keep.tip(Fasttree_mid, metadata |> filter(Sample %in% Fasttree_mid$tip.label) |> pull(Sample))

# Cophenetic Distances
cophenetic_matrix <- cophenetic(Fasttree_mid_clean)

# Reformat gene presence/absence data
gene_pres_abs_clean <- gene_pres_abs |>  
  dplyr::select(contains(c(NLD_samples, CDC_samples))) |>
  mutate(across(all_of(c(NLD_samples, CDC_samples)), ~ ifelse(. == "", 0, 1)))

# Accessory genome distances (jaccard dissimilarity)
jacc_dist <- jaccard(as.matrix(gene_pres_abs_clean))
```

# PCoA: Core Distances (cophenetic dist) = CONTROL
```{r}
# Prepare PCoA data
PCoA_Core <- wcmdscale(d = cophenetic_matrix, eig = TRUE, add=T)
PCoA_Core_res <-  data.frame(PCoA_Core$points)|> 
  mutate(Sample= rownames(data.frame(PCoA_Core$points)))

# Join with metadata
PCoA_Core_res_metadata <-  left_join(PCoA_Core_res |> dplyr::select(Sample, Dim1, Dim2), 
                            metadata |> dplyr::select(Sample, Country, SC))

mds.per.var1 <- round(100*eigenvals(PCoA_Core)/ sum(eigenvals(PCoA_Core)),2)

# PLOT
SC_colors <- c("#dbdb8d", "#1f77b4", "#ff7f0e", "#2ca02c", "#d62728", "#9467bd", 
                   "#8c564b", "#e377c2", "#7f7f7f", "#bcbd22", "#17becf",
                   "#f7b6d2", "#c5b0d5", "#c49c94")
names(SC_colors) <- as.character(1:14)

PCoA_Core_plot <- PCoA_Core_res_metadata %>%
  filter(SC %in% 1:14) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Dim1, y=Dim2)) +
  geom_point(aes(col = as.factor(SC), shape=Country), size = 2.5) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(x=Dim1, y=Dim2, fill=as.factor(SC)), geom = "polygon", alpha=0.35) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = paste("PCoA1 - ", mds.per.var1[1], "%", sep=""),
                y = paste("PCoA2 - ", mds.per.var1[2], "%", sep=""))+
  scale_color_manual(values= SC_colors)+
  scale_fill_manual(values= SC_colors, guide = 'none')+
  guides(color=guide_legend(title="Sequence\nClusters"))
PCoA_Core_plot

# Save
ggsave("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pangenome_analysis/4.PCoA_Core.png", plot = PCoA_Core_plot, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300, units = "in", bg = "white")

# PERMANOVA Cluster
groups_PERMANOVA_SC_Core<- as.factor(PCoA_Core_res_metadata$SC)
set.seed(1234)
PERMANOVA_SC_Core <- adonis2(cophenetic_matrix ~ groups_PERMANOVA_SC_Core)
PERMANOVA_SC_Core
# A higher R² indicates that a larger portion of the total variance is attributable to group differences, which implies stronger group differentiation.

# Permutation test for adonis under reduced model
# Permutation: free
# Number of permutations: 999
# 
# adonis2(formula = cophenetic_matrix ~ groups_PERMANOVA_SC_Core)
#            Df SumOfSqs      R2      F Pr(>F)    
# Model      37 0.245352 0.96664 2223.2  0.001 ***
# Residual 2839 0.008468 0.03336                  
# Total    2876 0.253820 1.00000                  
# ---
# Signif. codes:  0 ‘***’ 0.001 ‘**’ 0.01 ‘*’ 0.05 ‘.’ 0.1 ‘ ’ 1
```




# PCoA: Accessory Distances (Jaccard dist) = TEST
```{r}
# Prepare PCoA data
PCoA_Accessory <- wcmdscale(d = jacc_dist, eig = TRUE, add=T)
PCoA_Accessory_res <-  data.frame(PCoA_Accessory$points)|> 
  mutate(Sample= rownames(data.frame(PCoA_Accessory$points)))

PCoA_Accessory_res_metadata <-  left_join(PCoA_Accessory_res |> dplyr::select(Sample, Dim1, Dim2), 
                                          metadata |> dplyr::select(Sample, Country, SC))

mds.per.var1 <- round(100*eigenvals(PCoA_Accessory)/ sum(eigenvals(PCoA_Accessory)),2)

# PLOT
PCoA_Accessory_plot <- PCoA_Accessory_res_metadata %>%
  filter(SC %in% 1:14) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Dim1, y=Dim2)) +
  geom_point(aes(col = as.factor(SC), shape=Country), size = 2.5) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(x=Dim1, y=Dim2, fill=as.factor(SC)), geom = "polygon", alpha=0.35) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = paste("PCoA1 - ", mds.per.var1[1], "%", sep=""),
                y = paste("PCoA2 - ", mds.per.var1[2], "%", sep=""))+
  scale_color_manual(values= SC_colors)+
  scale_fill_manual(values= SC_colors, guide = 'none')+
  guides(color=guide_legend(title="Sequence\nClusters"))
PCoA_Accessory_plot

# Save
ggsave("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pangenome_analysis/4.PCoA_Accessory.png", plot = PCoA_Accessory_plot, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300, units = "in", bg = "white")

# PERMANOVA Cluster
groups_PERMANOVA_SC_Accessory <- as.factor(PCoA_Accessory_res_metadata$SC)
set.seed(1234)
PERMANOVA_SC_Accessory <- adonis2(jacc_dist ~ groups_PERMANOVA_SC_Accessory)
PERMANOVA_SC_Accessory

# Permutation test for adonis under reduced model
# Permutation: free
# Number of permutations: 999

# adonis2(formula = jacc_dist ~ groups_PERMANOVA_SC_Accessory)
#            Df SumOfSqs      R2      F Pr(>F)    
# Model      37   34.644 0.66178 150.14  0.001 ***
# Residual 2839   17.705 0.33822                  
# Total    2876   52.350 1.00000 

# https://stats.stackexchange.com/questions/617788/interpretation-of-r2-from-permanova-adonis2-in-vegan-package
```
